title: Aerated Chicken Tagine with Algerian Spices
description: A Chinese adaptation of the classic North African dish, featuring aerated chicken cooked in a tagine with Algerian spices.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
4. Add Algerian spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add beans, soy sauce, brown sugar, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
6. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and toasted almonds if desired.
